items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new implementation, spend, monetization expansion, and unsupported financial claims. Delivery is full at 10/10 slots, with 61 overflow items, 38 improvements awaiting measurement, and 17 failed requests. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the full amount is unattributed, so site revenue is unsupported. September 1–29 AI spend is $928.54 across 5,097 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but matching-period infrastructure, labor, domain, and operating costs are unavailable. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are therefore unknown. Sessions, impressions, clicks, proposal counts, and output volume are not financial performance. Continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation and measurement work.

Minimum finance artifact remains the existing report-only reconciliation: match the 18 named provider tracking rows and aggregate row for 2026-09-21 to site/content revenue, ordered and shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure cost, labor, other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved cost-to-learn threshold. Preserve unavailable values as unknown; do not extrapolate one-day commission or September AI spend into monthly revenue, margin, forecasts, payback, or learning claims.
